description: This file defines the API declarations for UPNP data models within the COSA Data Model Library. It includes function prototypes for getting and setting device parameters, validating, committing, and rolling back configurations, as well as similar APIs for CAPABILITIES objects. It is used to facilitate interactions with UPNP devices in the system.

methods.name: Device_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for the device.

methods.name: Device_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value for the device.

methods.name: Device_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value for the device.

methods.name: Device_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for the device.

methods.name: Device_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for the device.

methods.name: Device_SetParamIntValue
methods.description: Sets an integer parameter value for the device.

methods.name: Device_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long parameter value for the device.

methods.name: Device_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for the device.

methods.name: Device_Validate
methods.description: Validates device parameter values before commit.

methods.name: Device_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back the device configuration to previous state.

methods.name: Capabilities_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value from capabilities.

methods.name: Capabilities_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer parameter value from capabilities.

methods.name: Capabilities_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value from capabilities.

methods.name: Capabilities_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value from capabilities.
